about_the_game:
Drones Drop Bombs is an arcade where you protect your base and increase your score by destroying waves of robots with a combat drone.

  • Your options will include bombs, lasers and direct hits, but you should be careful to avoid drone or base destruction as there are no in-between saves: you fail, you have to start over.

It is also a game about overcoming your limitations with skill, precision and wits.

  • As you encounter different enemies with varying offensive tactics, you will have to adapt to new challenges while using the same tools you have from game start and throughout all levels.

When robots decided to overthrow the government, they didn't know about our backup plan:

  • stream a fake ad about "free upgrades today only!",

  • guide the machines to a secluded space

  • and destroy them with our bomb-dropping drones.

What could possibly go wrong?

Well, several things:

  • there is only one drone ready for combat;

    • "Are you sure we've planned ahead?"

  • it can't carry more than three bombs;

    • "Yeah, like someone will ever need more than that."

  • its lasers use electricity quite fast;

    • "Surely, a common oversight."

  • and finally, it won't survive too many direct hits.

    • "Indeed, we're not building a tank here."

Oh, also we don't have the budget for actual upgrades, so be sure to prevent robots from revealing our cards!

Defeat the robots in 50 levels, improve your high score and help humanity survive robot uprising!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains simplified and stylized depictions of drone warfare. Some game mechanics (e.g. bombs, explosions) and sounds may be considered violent or unsuitable for younger audiences or players with PTSD.
